en.title: Timothée Chalamet, Selena Gomez Team Up for Animated Rom-Com 'Not Alone'
en.summary: Get ready for a celestial romance with a cosmic twist! The first trailer for Illumination's 'Not Alone' has landed, giving us a glimpse of Timothée Chalamet and Selena Gomez as two brilliant minds on a mission.
en.body:
Universal Pictures and Illumination have officially unveiled the trailer for their upcoming animated feature, **Not Alone**, and it’s packed with star power and interstellar charm. Voicing the lead characters are none other than **Timothée Chalamet** and **Selena Gomez**, bringing to life a story that promises both heartfelt romance and out-of-this-world adventure.

The film centers on Joe, an introverted rocket scientist voiced by **Chalamet**, and Fran, an ambitious astro-botanist played by **Gomez**. They are brought together by a groundbreaking project at Space Burst: the development of a revolutionary plant-fueled rocket. While sparks fly between the two scientists, their romantic endeavors are less than stellar. Their budding relationship takes an unexpected turn when three tiny, unruly, and undeniably adorable aliens, Dunk, Welly, and Shirm, seek refuge in Joe’s home. These extraterrestrial refugees are on the run from a determined, albeit bumbling, law enforcement officer named Zandro, and their presence complicates Joe and Fran’s lives immeasurably.

## A Stellar Pairing for an Animated Adventure

The trailer sets a whimsical tone, underscored by a soundtrack that evokes classic space-themed anthems. It clearly highlights the chemistry between Joe and Fran, hinting at a sweet and relatable romantic subplot amidst the grander cosmic setting. **Chalamet**, fresh off his acclaimed roles in galactic epics, makes his animation debut, while **Gomez**, known for her engaging performances, adds another layer of appeal. The visual style, characteristic of Illumination, promises vibrant animation and endearing character designs, especially for the trio of alien visitors.

## What's Brewing for Sci-Fi Rom-Com Fans

**Not Alone** appears poised to capture the attention of fans who enjoy a blend of humor, romance, and science fiction. The inclusion of small, cute aliens fleeing a pursuer is a classic narrative device that often resonates with audiences of all ages. The official synopsis hints that the aliens might see Fran’s rocket as their ticket to freedom, setting up a potential conflict that will test Joe and Fran’s burgeoning bond and their dedication to their mission. It’s a premise that promises both lighthearted fun and genuine emotional stakes.

## Looking Ahead to Launch

**Not Alone** is slated for an April 2027 release. With the trailer now out, audiences can anticipate more sneak peeks and details about the film's narrative and its unique blend of human connection and alien encounters in the months leading up to its premiere.

tr.title: Timothée Chalamet ve Selena Gomez, 'Not Alone' Animasyon Romantik Komedyasında Bir Araya Geliyor
tr.summary: Timothée Chalamet ve Selena Gomez'in seslendirdiği 'Not Alone' animasyon filmi, uzayda geçen bir romantik komedi. Film, iki zeki bilim insanının hikayesini anlatıyor.
tr.body:
Universal Pictures ve Illumination, 'Not Alone' adlı yeni animasyon filminin fragmanını yayınladı. Filmin seslendirmenleri arasında Timothée Chalamet ve Selena Gomez gibi önemli isimler yer alıyor. Film, Joe adındaki içe dönük bir roket bilimcisi ve Fran adındaki hırslı bir astro-botanisti anlatıyor. İki bilim insanı, Space Burst'ta devrim niteliğinde bir bitki yakıtlı roket geliştirme projesinde bir araya gelir. Aralarında romantik duygular uyanırken, relationshipleri pek de parlak değil. Ancak Joe'nin evine sığınan üç küçük, sevimli ve kaçak uzaylı, Dunk, Welly ve Shirm, onların hayatlarını tamamen değiştirir. Bu uzaylılar, kararlı ama beceriksiz bir polis memuru olan Zandro'dan kaçmaktadır ve Joe ile Fran'ın hayatlarını karmaşıklaştırır. 

 ## Bir Animasyon Macerası için Yıldızlı Bir İkilinin Birleşmesi 

 Fragman, klasik uzay temalı şarkılarla zenginleştirilmiş bir soundtrack ile fantastik bir atmosfer yaratıyor. Joe ve Fran arasındaki kimyayı vurguluyor ve büyük uzay ortamı içinde tatlı ve ilgili bir romantik alt hikayeye işaret ediyor. Timothée Chalamet, galaktik epik rollerden sonra animasyon çıkışını yapıyor, Selena Gomez ise etkileyici performanslarıyla çekiciliğini artırıyor. Illumination'ın karakteristik görsel stili, özellikle üç uzaylı misafir için renkli animasyon ve sevimli karakter tasarımları vaat ediyor. 

 ## Bilim Kurgu Romantik Komedi Hayranları için Ne Bekliyor? 

 'Not Alone', mizah, romantizm ve bilim kurgunun karışımını seven hayranların dikkatini çekecek gibi görünüyor. Küçük, sevimli uzaylıların bir takipçiden kaçması, genellikle tüm yaş gruplarında izleyiciyle rezonans gösteren klasik bir anlatı cihazdır. Resmi özet, uzaylıların Fran'ın roketini özgürlük biletleri olarak görebileceğini ima ediyor ve bu da Joe ve Fran'ın gelişen bağlarını ve misyonlarına olan bağlılıklarını test edecek bir potansiyel çatışma yaratıyor. Hem lighthearted eğlence hem de gerçek duygusal riskler vaat eden bir premise. 

 ## Lansmana Doğru 

 'Not Alone', Nisan 2027'de vizyona girecek. Fragman yayınlandıktan sonra, izleyiciler film hakkında daha fazla ön gösterim ve ayrıntılar bekleyebilir.

es.title: Timothée Chalamet y Selena Gomez se unen para la comedia romántica animada 'Not Alone'
es.summary: Prepárate para un romance celestial con un toque cósmico. El primer tráiler de 'Not Alone' de Illumination ha llegado, dándonos un vistazo de Timothée Chalamet y Selena Gomez como dos mentes brillantes en una misión. La película promete una aventura llena de corazón y diversión fuera de este mundo.
es.body:
La Universal Pictures y Illumination han estrenado oficialmente el tráiler de su próxima película animada, **Not Alone**, y está lleno de estrellas y encanto interestelar. Los actores que dan voz a los personajes principales son none otros que **Timothée Chalamet** y **Selena Gomez**, quienes traen a la vida una historia que promete romance sincero y aventura fuera de este mundo.

La película se centra en Joe, un científico introvertido de cohetes voz por **Chalamet**, y Fran, una ambiciosa astro-botánica interpretada por **Gomez**. Son reunidos por un proyecto innovador en Space Burst: el desarrollo de un cohete revolucionario impulsado por plantas. Mientras que las chispas vuelan entre los dos científicos, sus esfuerzos románticos son menos que estelares. Su relación en ciernes toma un giro inesperado cuando tres pequeños, traviesos y adorables alienígenas, Dunk, Welly y Shirm, buscan refugio en la casa de Joe. Estos refugiados extraterrestres están huyendo de un oficial de la ley decidido, aunque torpe, llamado Zandro, y su presencia complica la vida de Joe y Fran de manera incalculable.

## Una pareja estelar para una aventura animada

El tráiler establece un tono caprichoso, subrayado por una banda sonora que evoca antiguas canciones temáticas espaciales. Destaca claramente la química entre Joe y Fran, insinuando un romance dulce y relatable en medio del gran escenario cósmico. **Chalamet**, fresco de sus aclamados papeles en épicos galácticos, hace su debut en la animación, mientras que **Gomez**, conocida por sus performances atractivas, agrega otra capa de atractivo. El estilo visual, característico de Illumination, promete animación vibrante y diseños de personajes encantadores, especialmente para el trío de visitantes alienígenas.

## ¿Qué se cuece para los fanáticos de la comedia romántica de ciencia ficción?

**Not Alone** parece estar en posición de captar la atención de los fanáticos que disfrutan de una mezcla de humor, romance y ciencia ficción. La inclusión de pequeños alienígenas adorables huyendo de un perseguidor es un dispositivo narrativo clásico que a menudo resuena con audiencias de todas las edades. La sinopsis oficial sugiere que los alienígenas pueden ver el cohete de Fran como su boleto a la libertad, estableciendo un conflicto potencial que pondrá a prueba el vínculo en ciernes de Joe y Fran y su dedicación a su misión. Es una premisa que promete diversión ligera y apuestas emocionales genuinas.

## Mirando hacia el lanzamiento

**Not Alone** está programado para su lanzamiento en abril de 2027. Con el tráiler ya disponible, las audiencias pueden anticipar más vistazos y detalles sobre la narrativa de la película y su mezcla única de conexión humana y encuentros alienígenas en los meses previos a su estreno.

content_raw: News Not Alone Not Alone Trailer Gives Us Timothée Chalamet, Selena Gomez & Cute Lil’ Aliens Seeing this and Disclosure Day back-to-back would be an interesting experience By Vanessa Armstrong | Published on June 30, 2026 Screenshot: Illumination/Universal Pictures Comment 0 Share New Share Not Alone Trailer Gives Us Timothée Chalamet, Selena Gomez & Cute Lil’ Aliens&url= target=”_blank” title=”Twitter”> Not Alone Trailer Gives Us Timothée Chalamet, Selena Gomez & Cute Lil’ Aliens” target=”_blank” title=”Pinterest”> Screenshot: Illumination/Universal Pictures You don’t need a version of David Bowie’s “Space Oddity” to understand that Universal Pictures/Illumination’s Not Alone is about the stars. And while today’s trailer is overlaid with just such a track, the cute little aliens and the main human characters working on a rocket ship convey that as well. The trailer also tells us, however, that the movie will focus on those two human characters and their burgeoning relationship. Those characters are an introverted rocket scientist named Joe (voiced by Dune ’s Timothée Chalamet) and an astro-botanist developing a plant-fueled rocket named Fran (voiced by Only Murders in the Building ’s Selena Gomez). Here’s the official synopsis, which sheds more light on the plot of the film: When Joe and Fran are brought together to prepare for the inaugural launch of this revolutionary rocket, there are immediate sparks, but neither is particularly adept at romance. Life becomes more complicated when three aliens—tiny, unruly and adorable—take refuge in Joe’s home. Dunk, Welly and Shirm are on the interplanetary run from a zealous-yet-inept officer of the law named Zandro. The aliens determine that Fran’s rocket could provide their means of getting back home to safety.  Let’s talk about those lil’ aliens! They’re voiced by Rob Brydon ( Barbie , The Trip ), Diane Morgan ( Cunk On, Mandy ) and Jamie Demetriou ( Cruella, Jay Kelly ), and clearly full of comic relief, and have a Minions vibe to them (though seem more like distant cousins than close relatives). The latter isn’t surprising given Illumination is behind the Despicable Me/Minions films. One co-director, in fact, is Eric Guillon, who was the designer for those features (and also co-directed Despicable Me 3 ). The other co-directors are Claire Dodgson (editor of The Lorax, Minions, Despicable Me 3, Minions: The Rise of Gru ) and Jonathan Del Val (co-director of Minions: The Rise of Gru and The Secret Life of Pets 2 ). Not Alone also features the voice of Brett Goldstein ( Ted Lasso ) as officer Zandro. Allison Janney ( The West Wing, The Diplomat ) and Lamorne Morris ( Fargo, Spider-Noir ) are also part of the supporting voice cast. The film premieres in theaters on April 16, 2027.
